title: Used for 1 hour, hasn't worked since
text:
Used for 1 hour, hasn't worked since. I've been on a hunt for a good space heater, and after using the Sharper Image Ceramic 3, the hunt will continue.

I used the heater for about an hour, turned it off, and it never turned on again. I've tried different outlets, rooms, etc., but even days later it still won't turn on.

While it worked, I didn't think it was anything special. Having to use the buttons on the top to control it was pretty annoying, and not having any braille or different-feeling buttons made it extra annoying because you had to look every time you wanted to push a button.

I also would have much preferred a different heating pattern. I like to use space heaters to warm my feet. Because this one was vertical, I could only heat one foot at a time. This doesn't subtract from the score (because I knew it was vertical to begin with).

I would not recommend this space heater, even if it worked. I would have expected more at this price point.
